newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank sells $15 mln at 26.375 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank sells $15 mln at 26.375 pesos.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank sold $15 million at 26.375 pesos in early deals on Friday, traders said.
It continued to sell dollars even after raising its overnight borrowing rate twice on Thursday by a total of 1.75 percentage points to 13 percent.
"The Central Bank wants to reassure the market he's still there selling dollars at 26.375 pesos," a foreign bank dealer said.
Traders said banks remained jittery due to the volatility in the region's financial markets caused by the problems of the Thai baht.
The peso continues to deal at 26.375 with volume at $23 million.
